name: writing-quality-editor
tagline_zh: 写字的人会喜欢：writing-quality-editor。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Writing Quality Editor (WQE) composes, assesses, revises, and adapts user-facing writing so it reads naturally while preserving meaning, claims, intent, voice, conditions, numbers, identifiers, exceptions, and risks. Use when a user asks to write, review, polish, fix, improve, supplement, clarify, translate, localize, or make a document sound natural; no skill or mode name is required. Covers READ
